cat << 'EOF' > /tmp/parse.py
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET, json
t=ET.parse('mjcf.xml'); r=t.getroot()
wb=r.find('worldbody')
joints=[]
def walk(b,depth=0):
    for j in b.findall('joint'):
        rng=j.get('range')
        cr=[float(x) for x in rng.split()] if rng else None
        joints.append({"name":j.get('name'),"type":j.get('type','hinge'),"axis":[float(x) for x in (j.get('axis') or '0 0 1').split()],"ctrlrange":cr})
    for fj in b.findall('freejoint'):
        pass
    for c in b.findall('body'):
        walk(c,depth+1)
# only robot chain under base_link
base=None
for b in wb.findall('body'):
    if b.get('name')=='base_link': base=b
walk(base)
acts=[]
for a in r.find('actuator'):
    cr=a.get('ctrlrange')
    acts.append({"name":a.get('name'),"joint":a.get('joint'),"ctrlrange":[float(x) for x in cr.split()] if cr else None})
# graspable free bodies
grasp=[b.get('name') for b in wb.findall('body') if b.find('freejoint') is not None]
print(json.dumps({"joints":joints,"acts":acts,"grasp":grasp},indent=1))
EOF
